scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @musefold/managed-fs run build && cd apps/desktop && electron-vite dev --config electron.vite.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @musefold/managed-fs run build && cd apps/desktop && electron-vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm run build && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/run-builder.mjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --mac --config.electronDist=../../node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.package:mac:adhoc: pnpm run build && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --mac --arm64 --dir --config.electronDist=../../node_modules/electron/dist && node scripts/sign-macos-adhoc.mjs && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --prepackaged ../../release/mac-arm64/Musefold.app
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --win
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @musefold/web-next run build && pnpm run build && playwright test -c tests/v25
scripts.test:e2e:live: node scripts/v25-live-verification.mjs && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build && playwright test -c tests/v25/playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck test build check:boundaries && pnpm run build:web
